name: Althea
source:
Althea is a mysterious girl who [url=/c91946/]Aspen[/url] encounters inside Mrs Leigh’s old home.

Aspen has no idea why Althea is so intrigued by Mrs Leigh's home, or what connection she has to the elderly Mrs Leigh… But she has quite the vested interest in Aspen.

Cheerful and irreverent, Althea is quite the charming companion… But she’s fond of twisting the truth to suit her own means, and she always tells lies.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=57406&p=521823#p521823]Lemma soft[/url]]
